questions.question: India has won two gold medals at the 45th Chess Olympiad in September 2024. Where did this Chess Olympiad take place?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Budapest, Hungary**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 45th Chess Olympiad was held in Budapest, Hungary.**
 
• India secured gold medals in both the open and women’s categories.
 
• The open team, featuring players like **Arjun Erigaisi and Gukesh D, claimed their first-ever gold**__ after a critical win and China dropping points.
 
• **The women's team, led by Harika Dronavalli, dominated Azerbaijan to secure their victory.**
 
• This achievement marked India's first gold in the open section.
 
• PM Modi praised the teams for their stellar performances on social media.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• The Indian men's team won gold after a decisive victory in the final round.
 
• The women's team defeated Azerbaijan to clinch their gold medal.
 
• This historic win is seen as a new chapter in India's sporting history.

questions.question: What is the name of the online vaccine management portal that PM Modi has launched in October 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**U-WIN**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The U-WIN portal is designed to maintain a digital record of vaccinations and medications.**
 
• **It targets pregnant women and children from birth to 17 years of age.**
 
• Currently, the portal is operational on a pilot basis.
 
• PM Modi is expected to officially launch the portal in October 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The portal will enhance the tracking and management of vaccinations in India.
 
• Union Health Minister J P Nadda announced the launch at a press conference regarding the government's achievements.
 
• The expanded Ayushman Bharat scheme will also be introduced alongside, benefiting senior citizens.

questions.question: At which location is the second phase of Exercise** Tarang Shakti 24** was conducted? (September 2024)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Air Force Station Jodhpur.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The second phase of Exercise Tarang Shakti 24 was held at Air Force Station Jodhpur.**
 
• This phase of the exercise ran from August 30 to September 13.
 
• Participating nations include** Australia, Greece, Sri Lanka, the UAE, Japan, Singapore, and the United States.**
 
• Australia has deployed three EA-18G Growler aircraft and up to 120 personnel for this exercise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The first phase of Exercise Tarang Shakti took place in Tamil Nadu in August.**
 
• **Exercise Tarang Shakti is India’s largest multilateral air exercise.**
 
• Australia’s participation in this exercise highlights the country's commitment to regional stability and interoperability.
 
• Exercise Tarang Shakti includes multiple nations to foster international cooperation in addressing security challenges.

questions.question: Who was recently honored with the prestigious Ramon Magsaysay Award, often referred to as Asia's Nobel Prize, in 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hayao Miyazaki**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ****Hayao Miyazaki**, co-founder of Studio Ghibli, was honored with the 2024 Ramon Magsaysay Award, often referred to as Asia's Nobel Prize.**
 
• Miyazaki is a renowned film director known for critically acclaimed movies such as *Spirited Away*, *My Neighbor Totoro*, *Princess Mononoke*, and *Howl's Moving Castle*.
 
• **The award recognizes individuals and organizations that have significantly impacted Asia. It was created in tribute to former Philippine President Ramon Magsaysay.**
 
• Miyazaki was praised for using art to help children understand complex issues like environmental conservation and promoting peace through his animated films.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Studio Ghibli, co-founded by Miyazaki, recently became the first group to be awarded the honorary Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival.
 
• Miyazaki came out of retirement to create *The Boy and the Heron*, which received critical acclaim and won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
 
• The Ramon Magsaysay Award ceremony will be held in Manila in November 2024.

questions.question: Which team won the Durand Cup 2024 by defeating Mohun Bagan SG 4-3 in a penalty shootout?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**NorthEast United FC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NorthEast United FC won the Durand Cup 2024 by defeating Mohun Bagan Super Giant 4-3 in a penalty shootout at the Salt Lake Stadium, Kolkata.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Mohun Bagan had a 2-0 lead in the first half with goals from** Jason Cummings (penalty) and Sahal Abdul Samad.**
 
• NorthEast United equalized with goals from** Alaaeddine Ajaraie and Guillermo Fernandez** in the second half.
 
• The match went directly to penalty shootouts after regulation time.
 
• **Gurmeet Singh, NorthEast United’s goalkeeper,** made two crucial saves during the shootout, denying Liston Colaco and Subhasish Bose.
 
• This is **NorthEast United's first Durand Cup** win since their inception 10 years ago.
 
• **Jithin M.S.** was awarded the Golden Ball for providing the most assists in the tournament.

questions.question: What is the name of the mission approved by the Union Cabinet to improve weather and climate forecasting in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mission Mausam**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Mausam was approved by the Union Cabinet with an outlay of Rs. 2,000 crore over two years.**
 
• **It aims to enhance India’s weather and climate-related science, research, and services.**
 
• The mission will include advanced observation systems, high-performance computing, AI, and machine learning for precise weather forecasting.
 
• It will directly benefit several sectors like agriculture, disaster management, defence, environment, aviation, and more by providing accurate and timely weather information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Next-Gen Technology:** The mission will deploy next-generation radars, satellite systems, and high-performance supercomputers with advanced sensors.
 
• **Key Institutions:** The mission will be implemented by the **India Meteorological Department, the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, and the National Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasting.**
 
• **Global Collaboration:** The mission will also involve collaboration with national and international institutes, academia, and industries.
 
• **Areas of Impact:** It will improve predictions for monsoon forecasts, air quality alerts, extreme weather events, and more, benefiting sectors like agriculture, disaster management, and health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Capacity Building:** The mission aims to enhance India's capacity in weather surveillance, modelling, and forecasting.
 
• **Earth System Models:** The mission will develop advanced Earth system models for improved decision-making.
 
• **Real-Time Data Dissemination:** The mission will deploy a GIS-based automated Decision Support System for real-time weather and climate data dissemination.
 
• **Climate Resilience:** It will help strengthen climate resilience across sectors and communities, addressing the impacts of climate change effectively.

questions.question: What is the name of the joint military exercise between India and Oman, that was conducted in September 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Exercise Al Najah**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The joint military exercise between India and Oman is named Exercise Al Najah.**
 
• **The 5th edition of Exercise Al Najah was held from 13th to 26th September 2024 at the Rabkoot Training Area in Salalah, Oman.**
 
• This biennial exercise focuses on enhancing joint military capabilities, specifically counter-terrorism operations in desert environments.
 
• Both the Indian Army and the Royal Army of Oman are participating with 60 personnel each in this joint exercise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Desert Operations:** The exercise focuses on tactical drills in a desert environment, including counter-drone operations and room intervention.
 
• **Counter-Terrorism Focus:** The primary objective is to rehearse joint planning and counter-terrorism operations under Chapter VII of the United Nations Charter.
 
• **Interoperability and Cooperation:** This exercise fosters interoperability and cooperation between the two armies, strengthening their defense ties.
 
• **Past Editions:** The last edition of Exercise Al Najah was conducted at Mahajan, Rajasthan in 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• OMAN:

 
 
• The Sultanate of Oman is a country in Arabia.
 
• It is located on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula, and overlooks the mouth of the Persian Gulf.
 
• It shares land borders with Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Yemen.
 
• The capital and largest city is Muscat. 
 
• Currency: Omani Rial.
 
• Official language: Arabic.

questions.question: At the India Sugar and Bio-Energy conference, India's Food Minister Pralhad Joshi announced that India has become the world’s ______ largest producer and consumer of ethanol.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Third**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ** India is now the world’s third-largest producer and consumer of ethanol, according to Food and Public Distribution Minister Pralhad Joshi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The announcement was made during the** India Sugar and Bio-Energy conference in New Delhi.**
 
• The government is committed to a sustainable sugar industry that supports both economic growth and renewable energy.
 
• Over the past decade, **sugarcane cultivation increased by 18%, while sugarcane production grew by 40%.**
 
• The Minimum Support Price (MSP) system has resolved farmer dues, ensuring timely payments.
 
• Farmers now play a crucial role in renewable energy, transitioning from** "Anna Dattas" (food providers) to "Urja Dattas" (energy providers).**
 
• The government launched the** National Green Hydrogen Mission in 2023 with a budget of ₹19,744 crore** to position India as a global leader in the production, use, and export of green hydrogen.
